svg.title: A write-write conflict and its retry
svg.desc: Connection A begins a transaction and reads Ada's role as engineer. Connection B then commits a change to Ada's role in autocommit. A still reads engineer from its pinned view; when A commits its own change to Ada, the commit fails with a retryable write-write conflict. A begins again, reads B's committed value, writes, and commits.
